name: bx-distance-models
description: High-performance nucleotide sequence distance calculations compiled to WebAssembly

scripts.test:node: wasm-pack build --release --target nodejs --out-dir pkg-node && node tests/node/smoke.mjs
scripts.bench:build: npm run bench:build:kernels && npm run bench:build:api
scripts.bench:build:kernels: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path bench/kernels/Cargo.toml && RUSTFLAGS='-C target-feature=+simd128' cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path bench/kernels/Cargo.toml --target-dir bench/kernels/target/simd
